messages:
alex: Heads-up — found confusing wording in the docs around privileged audit log retention and a Ruby SDK snippet. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/audit/privileged-logs

maria: thanks — can you paste the exact snippet/line? I'll open a PR.

alex: in the 'Retention' section it says "90 days default" but the API surface docs say "customer-managed TTL". mixed signals. Also the Ruby snippet still uses `client.audit.export`.

kevin: for SOC2 language let's be precise: suggest "tenant-configurable retention (default 90 days); exports available for audits; staff access governed by emergency process". avoids vague wording.

maria: will draft. also noticed the Ruby SDK method rename — we should update Ruby + Python + curl examples to match the new `audit_export` call.

jamal: pinging @docs-bot for a quick link-check of pages under /audit/**.
docs-bot: queued link-check for /audit/** — expecting results in ~5m.

alex: one more ask: add a compact JSONL example for the "privileged_event" type that demonstrates pseudonymization (tenant-scoped pseudonym tokens).

maria: copying a minimal example into thread (will escape for docs):

maria: ```json
{"event_type":"privileged_event","user_id":"pseudonym:U_12345","action":"ssh_key_install","timestamp":"2025-11-01T12:34:56Z","details":{"host":"host-01"}}
```

kevin: that JSONL looks good. For SOC2 wording add parenthetical: "(Redwood administrators do not have plaintext tenant data access except under documented emergency procedures)".

alex: and update the curl examples to include `--header 'Accept: application/jsonl'` and the new endpoint path `/v1/audit/export`.

maria: opening PR now. Draft title: "privileged-logs: clarify retention + update SDK + add JSONL example". PR number will be posted.

kevin: add a changelog entry for docs release notes and mark it as a docs-only change.

jamal: docs-bot: link-check finished — found 2 broken links: /sdk/ruby/audit_export (404) and /examples/jsonl-schema (404).

maria: thanks — I'll adjust the paths and add redirects for backward compatibility.

alex: small language nit: replace "we may access" with "Redwood staff access requires documented emergency approval" — less ambiguous.

kevin: LGTM on the wording change.

jamal: +1. I'll loop legal for a quick read because we reference SOC2 and admin access.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4128 — PTAL. Netlify preview up.

docs-bot: deploy-preview created — https://deploy-preview-4128--docs.redwood.ai

kevin: planning to merge EOD after a quick legal peek.

jamal: added legal reviewer @sophia-legal to the PR.

sophia-legal: quick skim — high level looks fine. two suggestions: swap "customer-managed TTL" -> "tenant-configurable retention period" and add a link to our legal playbook for emergency access process. otherwise approve.

maria: updated per legal. final wording in docs: "Tenant-configurable retention period (default 90 days). Exports supported for audits. Redwood staff access requires documented emergency approval."

alex: looks good, thanks everyone :tada:

maria: merging after docs CI completes. I'll also add a short internal note about the SDK rename so SDK owners can cut a tiny patch release.

kevin: thumbs up.

jamal: closing the loop — I'll verify the redirect coverage for the old SDK URLs post-merge.

maria: thanks — that should resolve the user support tickets we've seen.

alex: appreciate the quick turnaround.
